description.value: Metro Liquor Tsawwassen is a private specialty liquor store voted South Delta's #1, located in the Tsawwassen Mills area. The store is stocked by specialist buyers focused on hard-to-find products, local craft beer and cider, and organic and biodynamic wines, with a rotating selection of limited releases. A liquor concierge service is also available for event planning and Special Event Permits.
